body: Vinit Teredesai (CFO) on 2025-10-14 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "We anticipate an impact of 180 basis points on next quarter's margins due to wage hikes. However, on an overall basis, up to 80 to 100 basis points of this impact is expected to get offset" Metric: EBIT margin Q3FY26 (company). Target: ~15.3-15.5% (16.3% less net 80-100 bp). Deadline: 2025-12-31. Specificity: range; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: delivered. Evidence: Q3FY26 reported EBIT 14.4% incl. a one-time 230 bp New Labour Code provision (government change, sector-wide); excluding it 16.7% (+40 bp QoQ) - the wage walk was beaten. Clarification C: delivered on the adjusted basis, both numbers shown; single-source.

body: Saurabh Goel (CFO) on 2025-10-24 (Q2FY26 concall transcript (company website)): "ETR on a sustained basis is roughly 23.5% to 24% is what a sustained ETR is what we would maintain" Metric: Effective tax rate (normalised). Target: 23.5-24%. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-22: partly. Evidence: FY26 normalised ETR 23%, reported 13% (Cigniti-merger tax true-up, Q4 ETR -7%). Normalised is 0.5 pp below the band floor (lower tax is not adverse, but the forecast was off); FY27 guide reset to 23-24%.
